title: Sunday · eight flyers
logline: The shack's wall with eight crab flyers on it, 1998 to 2005, the hands changing already. The first Sunday about the wall itself.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the shingle wall beside Gully's door with eight flyers pinned in a row, weathered to new, the crabs changing hand by hand.

image.prompt: a shingle wall beside a shack door with eight hand-lettered crab flyers pinned in a row from weathered to new, no words legible

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the first, close: one enormous crab, a Rohmer quote in tiny hand nobody reads, sun-bleached.

image.prompt: close on a sun-bleached hand-drawn flyer with one enormous crab and a line of tiny unreadable text beneath it

panels.name: First

panels.composition: Tier 3: the newest beside the oldest. The same crab. The line steadier. Held.

image.prompt: two crab flyers side by side on a shingle wall, one bleached and one fresh, the same crab drawn with a steadier line, no words

panels.name: Newest

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: Eight flyers. The wall as a Sunday.
